outreach.subject: A free credit card payoff tool for your readers
outreach.body:
Hi [Name],

I enjoyed your post "[their post title]" — especially [one specific point].

I run HomeMoney Calc, a free, no-sign-up set of US money calculators. Our credit card payoff calculator might be a useful extra for that post: https://homemoneycalc.com/credit-card-payoff-calculator/ (example: $6,000 at 22.9%, paying $250 → Paid off in 2 yr 9 mo).

If it helps your readers, you're welcome to link it or embed it (free embed code is at the bottom of the page). No pressure at all if it's not a fit.

Thanks,
[Your name]
Founder, HomeMoney Calc

ai.headline: Cloudflare monitoring check karein aur Wave 1 calculators prepare karein
ai.summary: Site par abhi 0 clicks aur 0 sessions hain kyunki site nayi hai. Automated checks me Cloudflare ne 7 internal requests block kiye hain, par site down nahi hai. Technical health audit clean hai (22 pages, 0 errors). Abhi hume Cloudflare settings check karni hai, Week 1 ke bache setup tasks complete karne hain, aur 28 Oct ke planned calculators ke tax numbers officially verify karne hain. AdSense ke liye abhi apply nahi karna hai.
youDo: Cloudflare Dashboard (dash.cloudflare.com) me login karein aur Security Events check karein ki automated monitoring requests block kyun hui. Apne browser me site open karke live access verify karein (30 mins).

Week 1 Growth Tasks: Google Analytics 4 (analytics.google.com) setup complete karein aur Ahrefs Webmaster Tools (ahrefs.com/webmaster-tools) verify karein taaki organic traffic aur backlinks track ho sakein (45 mins).
Senior Deduction Calculator ($6,000) aur 2027 COLA Calculator ke official tax numbers IRS/SSA sources se verify karein taaki 28 Oct ko live ja sakein (30 mins).
agentNext: IRS/SSA official guidelines ke hisab se 2027 tax engine update (lib/tax2027.ts) ka code prepare rakhna.
Drafted roadmap calculators (Senior Deduction, Social Security COLA, No Tax on Overtime) ke validation logic aur schema checks review karna.
Cloudflare edge access resolve hote hi live status re-check karna.
risks: Cloudflare bot protection agar search bots ya monitoring ko block karega toh indexing me rukawat aa sakti hai.
Zero organic traffic par AdSense apply karne se application reject ho sakti hai — pehle stable visitors earn karna zaroori hai.
Bina official IRS/SSA source verification ke tax calculations live karne se user trust aur accuracy policy par asar pad sakta hai.
